_comment: Ratchet for `homelab mutants`: undetected (survived + untested) mutants per file. Counts may be lowered or removed, never added or raised by hand -- with one measured exception, below. Regenerate with `homelab mutants --update-baseline` after an improvement. Scope lives in [tool.mutmut].only_mutate in pyproject.toml. Baseline is riven-relative; see AGENTS.md.
_drift: module_support.py and normalize.py are NOT reproducible: repeated fresh sweeps on riven give 34-35 and 161-166 from an unchanged tree, and a GitHub runner gives 36-37 and 176-179. Their entries are therefore pinned to riven's observed ceiling rather than to the last sweep, so a re-sweep does not fail the gate on noise alone. A drop below the floor is a real improvement; a rise above the ceiling is a real regression. The other four files are exact on every run and every machine, so they carry no allowance. Re-running --update-baseline will overwrite these two with that sweep's figure -- restore the ceiling by hand.
